components.name: FileDiff
components.doc: A unified diff of one file, computed from the text before and after. Changed lines carry line numbers, a sign and a tint; the part of a line that actually changed is marked. Long unchanged runs fold into one row that springs open, and the header counts additions and removals.

members.name: filename
members.doc: Path of the file, shown in the header. The last segment is emphasized.

members.name: previousFilename
members.doc: Earlier path, when the change also renamed the file.

members.name: before
members.doc: Text of the file before the change. Empty for a new file.

members.name: after
members.doc: Text of the file after the change. Empty for a deleted file.

members.name: context
members.doc: Unchanged lines kept visible around every change. Longer unchanged runs fold into one expandable row.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Tallest the diff body grows before it scrolls, as a CSS length or a number of pixels.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the diff body is open (controlled).

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the diff body starts open (uncontrolled).

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the header toggle opens or closes the diff body.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.
